entries.label: Bravery
cells: Study: Minimum DMG is at least 15% of Max, and you now skip trivial fights!

entries.label: Evertree
cells: Study: Every trunk whittled lowers the resources needed to destroy other skilling caverns by 5%

entries.label: Fountain
cells: Study: You can Marbleize upgrades more than once! Also, 1.05x higher Marble production!

entries.label: Gambit
cells: Study: +5% Total Gambit Points. Also, 50% chance to not use up your daily Gambit attempt when starting a Gambit!

entries.label: Grotto
cells: Study: Each Gloomie kill counts for 1.01x more toward challenging the Monarch

entries.label: Justice
cells: Study: Justice Reward Multi goes up 100% every day for +14 more days! Also, 2x chance for opal reward!

entries.label: Motherlode
cells: Study: Every layer destroyed lowers the resources needed to destroy other skilling caverns by 2%

entries.label: Temple
cells: Study: There is an extra +30% chance to get double torches when picking them up!

entries.label: The Bell
cells: Study: Every 20th Bell Ring gives a random bonus +20 LVs. Biiig Ring baby!

entries.label: The Cove
cells: Study: The first 1 upgrades each day in The Cove are 15% cheaper

entries.label: The Den
cells: Study: Defeating the Golden Hound gives a 1.05x score multi and spawns another Golden Hound!

entries.label: The Harp
cells: Study: All strings give 2x EXP, and have a 1% chance of getting a massive 100x EXP multi

entries.label: The Hive
cells: Study: Every hive harvested lowers the resources needed to destroy other skilling caverns by 5%

entries.label: The Jars
cells: Study: Double click to choose a collectible to be most likely enchanted! Also, 1.25x Enchantment Chance!

entries.label: The Lamp
cells: Study: Get 1 more lamp wishes every day. No, you can't wish to change this!

entries.label: The Well
cells: Study: You only lose 25% sediment when bar expanding instead of 50% Also, +10% Bucket Fill Rate per Bar Expansion

entries.label: Trench
cells: Study: Every depth cast lowers the resources needed to destroy other skilling caverns by 3%

entries.label: Wisdom
cells: Study: If you end a round with no instamatches, you get one! Also, start with 1 more attempts!

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 18 caverns in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
